title: Flu 2026-27, Round 1
summary: Vaccine coverage scenarios A-D, Oct 2026 - Jun 2027. Three strains (H1, H3, B), five age groups, US + 50 states + DC.
about: Three-strain (H1, H3, B), five-age compartmental model calibrated to NHSN admissions (Aug 2025 - Oct 3, 2026), national lab subtype shares and the 2025-26 death estimate. Seasonality comes from a fixed calendar (school breaks, pre-holiday mixing, winter break) with learned strengths. Pick a location; every parameter can be changed and the model is re-solved in your browser for that location.
